citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany an APHIS Official during the inspection process at 9:00am on
6/9/2026. An attempt had also been made on Monday, June 1 and Monday June 8. The inspector attempted to contact
the licensee/registrant by calling the phone, honking the car horn, knocking on door, waiting 40 minutes for response.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
